findings.title: Verify present-day support for Japanese 日 senses
findings.details: The supplied article marks 日:japan_abbreviation as current, but its citations establish only contemporary Chinese usage. The other prior findings mention 日:japan and 日:days_counter, which are absent from this article; they do not establish a defect in those records here. No Japanese present-use evidence is supplied for a Japanese sense in this candidate.
findings.verification: Inspect the current sense record and generated has_sense edge. Either support any Japanese current sense with an authoritative Japanese source or remove/reclassify it; then obtain fresh factual and readability approvals. For 日:japan_abbreviation, retain the current Chinese status only if the citations clearly identify it as a Chinese abbreviation.
